title: TCLK Signature Airlock Request Envelope
$comment: The inner airlock door. Carries only what an operator needs to decide and what a signer needs to sign. additionalProperties is false at every level so no extra field can ride along; the runtime sentinel in blackbox/airlock/envelope.mjs additionally rejects secret-SHAPED values (PEM private keys, mnemonics, xprv, DPAPI blobs) that a schema cannot see. There is deliberately no property for a seed, private key, passphrase, decrypted blob, payment witness or environment secret, and no nonce: the room-message nonce is reserved inside the signer custody boundary.

requestId.description: Derived from requestFingerprint. Local operator-safety identity only; it is NOT a Technocore protocol nonce and claims no network-level replay protection.

requestFingerprint.description: sha256 over the binding core: schema, createdAt, upstream sha/package, frameType, contractId, signerDid, canonicalPayload, canonicalHash, intendedRoom, intendedOperation.

upstream.description: The exact upstream pin whose canonicalization produced canonicalPayload. A signature is only meaningful against the encoder that produced the bytes.

signerDid.description: Public DID only. The airlock never receives the corresponding private key.

canonicalPayload.description: The EXACT bytes a signature will cover, produced by upstream encodeFrame and proven round-trip stable.

canonicalHash.description: sha256 of canonicalPayload. A convenience for display and binding, never a substitute for the bytes.

intendedRoom.description: Destination room this frame would be posted to if posting were ever enabled.

nonceOwner.description: States explicitly that nonce reservation lives inside custody, outside BYTE FREEZE.

sweepIsIdentity.description: False means the venue single-line sweep would alter these bytes, so a signature would cover the swept form instead.

publicPostingEnabled.description: Phase 3A invariant. A request that claims otherwise is refused at the post-eligibility gate.

human.description: Dual representation, right-hand column. Advisory prose only: the signature covers canonicalPayload, not this.
